title: [CQ-R02p] Package provider prerequisite helpers
description: Objective: ship the read-only R02 provider modules/manifest through both existing IDE bundles and permanent CI. Deliverable: explicit Gradle and VS Code production asset inclusion, bundled onboarding assertions, and a real temporary VS Code bundle regression. Not in scope: provisioning, installed-runtime protection, strict profile activation, or any actual VM support claim. Preserve current CRLF and pre-existing dirty files. Verification: node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bundle.test.mjs. Real JetBrains build stays in CI/final integration because local Java is absent.
definitionOfDone: Both bundle definitions include all production local-runner modules and pinned manifest, excluding tests.
A temporary fixture executes the actual VS Code bundler and imports the copied helper/manifest; removing copy behavior makes the test fail.
Bundled onboarding refuses missing helper assets; CI explicitly runs provider and bundle tests.
Fresh Node provider/bundle suites exit0; no execution-ready or hardware certification claims.
taskRails: No source outside five planned files; preserve CRLF/BOM.
No agent Git writes or manual .moe edits.

implementationPlan.description: Write a Node-native packaging regression that copies the actual VS Code bundler into an isolated temporary repo, provides minimal dist/dependency/role/mod fixtures, seeds the actual production provider helper directory plus a sentinel test file, and runs the real bundler. Assert copied module/manifest importability and test-file exclusion. Add a precise Gradle inclusion contract assertion plus bundled onboarding expected-file assertions. Demonstrate red from missing helper copy, not missing unrelated build prerequisites. Error handling and tests are required.

Add explicit production local-runner inclusion to both existing bundle paths (no floating copies of arbitrary tests). Extend packaged onboarding to require modules and manifest, and the cross-platform CI Node list to execute provider and packaging tests. Use byte-aware focused edits to preserve original CRLF and unrelated content. Do not build/provision VMs or enable callers.

Run node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bundle.test.mjs fresh. Perform one final adversarial review for nested asset paths, missing files, test leakage, shell/path handling and false installed-runtime claims. Report local Java absence honestly; do not claim a JetBrains archive build.
